reason: I already have a drawer full of half-used bottles and I don't buy supplements unless my doctor says so. The lab report and the money-back thing are nice, but I'd still be paying $25 to find out if I feel anything.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? A tested, clean capsule doesn't tell me it works for me, and my doctor hasn't told me to take magnesium.
would_change_my_mind: My doctor telling me to take magnesium, or a friend I trust saying it really helped her sleep.
